title.narrative: Fact-Finding Mission: Assessing Support to Chapter 27 Negotiations
Förstudie framtagande av stöd kapitel 27 förhandlingar

description.narrative: Denna insats är en förstudie, vilken kommer att vara ett kortvarigt, expertdrivet uppdrag som förväntas resultera i en väl underbyggd strategi och ett projektdokument för fortsatt svenskt stöd till Albaniens EU-förhandlingar. Det övergripande målet med insatsen är att göra en bedömning av var Albanien står när det gäller anpassning och kapacitet att tillämpa EU:s regelverk i kapitel 27. Specifika mål är att: •Identifiera luckor i kapacitet och behov av stöd till den albanska regeringen i förhandlingar, före och efter öppnandet av kluster 4 i EU förhandlingarna. •Informera förberedelsen av en insats för nästa fas av stöd för förhandlingarna om kapitel 27.

The fact finding mission is a short-term, expert-driven assignment which will result in a well-informed strategy and proposal for continued Swedish support to Albania’s EU negotiations The overarching objective of the fact-finding mission is to provide an assessment of where Albania stands in terms if alignment and capacity to apply the EU aquis in Chapter 27. Specific objectives are to: •Identify the needs and gaps for support to Albanian Government to negotiations, pre- and post-Cluster 4 opening. •Inform the preparation of the Project Document for next phase of support for Chapter 27 negotiations.

title.narrative: Grant Agreement between Sida and SEI regarding Fact Finding Mission: Assessing Support to Chapter 27 Negotiations

description.narrative:
The FFM Report delivered a comprehensive analysis of the main challenges, bottlenecks and gaps affecting Albania's progress under Chapter 27, alongside a detailed assessment of financial needs and funding flows. Through a mixed method approach combining existing evidence, capacity assessments and lessons learned from comparable accession processes, including a relevant case study from Estonia, the report generated a robust analytical foundation for future support.
Its findings directly informed the design of a subsequent intervention (17529 UNDP/SEI Reform accelerator for EU chapter 27 environment and climate), which was approved and has entered the implementation phase. The method used served to anchor the suggested approach with the beneficiary institutions and to provide evidence base for the coming intervention.
The report also provided practical recommendations for addressing the Chapter 27 closing benchmarks, contributing to Albania's EU accession efforts and offering insights of broader relevance for environmental governance and compliance reforms.
